item.description:
• First release of Notemall: fast notes for Mac, kept as plain Markdown files in a folder you choose
  • Type / to add headings, to-dos, tables, callouts, code and images
  • Link notes with [[ and see every note that links back
  • Pick a day for a note and it comes back in Today, with Upcoming and a calendar
  • Folders, tags, themes and ⌘K to find or create anything
  • Ask your notes with Apple Intelligence, and connect assistants through MCP
